title: Wolf and Oath
author: Theo Sterling
blurb: Yara Okonkwo, an exiled storm-caller, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
